subject: Pilot continuity request while PO clears (CedarWave)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Anna Liu <anna.liu@cedarwave.com>, procurement@cedarwave.com <procurement@cedarwave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot continuity request while PO clears (CedarWave)

Hi Anna / CedarWave procurement team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — the technical deep-dive went well and the product demo with your clinical data team is booked for next Thursday (Sept 17). Your PO is in motion per your note, understood. We’re seeing the CedarWave sandbox close to critical usage thresholds and I wanted to raise a short request to avoid demo interruption while finance finishes the PO.

Ask: would you be open to Redwood provisioning a temporary pilot voucher (7 days) to keep the demo environment live while your purchasing team completes the PO? If finance requires a short invoice or vendor form from us to speed things along, I can loop legal/ops immediately.

Why this helps: the demo scheduled is a high-leverage session with the clinical leadership — preserving the live environment keeps momentum and reduces the chance the evaluation stalls. We’ll only enable the temporary credits tied to the CedarWave tenant and remove access automatically when the PO posts.

Attached: SOW_CedarWave_v1.pdf (scope + pilot terms).

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
(d) 415-555-0123 | dylan.brooks@redwood.com

From: Anna Liu <anna.liu@cedarwave.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cedarwave.com <procurement@cedarwave.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot continuity request while PO clears (CedarWave)

Dylan —

Thanks for the note and for the SOW. We do want the demo to proceed next week. Quick update from our side: the PO is routed but finance needs two things before they can release spend — (1) a completed W-9 (we don’t have one on file for Redwood) and (2) our vendor onboarding questionnaire completed. I’ve copied procurement who can confirm the precise doc fields.

Procurement, can you confirm gap and expected days to clear?

If Redwood can provide a short-term voucher it would help, but I need to make sure procurement is aligned — we can’t accept pre-paid vendor credits without a PO exception. Happy to take a short call if that helps.

Thanks,
Anna Liu
Director of Engineering, CedarWave Health
anna.liu@cedarwave.com

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T16:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot continuity request while PO clears (CedarWave)

Marissa / Ben — forwarding CedarWave’s ask. PO is en route but Anna says finance needs W-9 and vendor onboarding completed. They’re worried the team will hit the sandbox cap before Thurs’s demo.

Could we provision a short runway while procurement/finance finishes? Specific proposal: a time-limited voucher for CedarWave tenant that unlocks 10,000 tokens or 7 days of access (whichever comes first). We’ll auto-revoke when PO posts.

Reasons to approve: preserves momentum for a likely mid-market opportunity, demo scheduled with CLIN lead on Sept 17, small one-time cost relative to expected ARR.

Attached: PO_status_screenshot.png (customer screenshot showing routing status).

If you OK this, I’ll coordinate the conditional terms with Anna and flag any finance requirements (e.g., W-9).

Cheers,
Dylan

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot continuity request while PO clears (CedarWave)

+1 to a short runway. My recommendation: approve a guarded, auditable voucher — 5 calendar days / 8k tokens — and require that the CedarWave PO or vendor paperwork be submitted within that window. If procurement fails to deliver, we revoke immediately.

Marissa — can you sign off on up to 8k tokens? If they need more than that, we should require a manager-level approval + finance notification.

I’ll draft the one-off terms (simple addendum) so legal overhead is minimal.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T18:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot continuity request while PO clears (CedarWave)

Ben / Dylan — temporary approval granted. Authorize up to 72 hours (3 days) and 10,000 tokens for CedarWave tenant, conditional on: (1) formal PO reference or vendor paperwork submitted within the 72-hour window; (2) ticket logged with CS ops for removal once PO posts; (3) finance copied on confirmation email.

Dylan — proceed, make the conditions explicit to Anna and procurement. Ben — please prep the short addendum language and loop legal if they push back.

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Anna Liu <anna.liu@cedarwave.com>, procurement@cedarwave.com <procurement@cedarwave.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T18:10:00-07:00
Subject: CedarWave — provisional access approved (72 hours / 10k tokens)

Anna / CedarWave procurement — quick update: Marissa approved a provisional 72-hour runway and up to 10,000 tokens to keep the demo/live sandbox operational for your team. Conditions: please submit PO reference or onboarding paperwork within 72 hours; finance must be copied on that submission. We will automatically revoke access if paperwork is not provided in the window.

Next steps for you: send W-9 and vendor form to us (legal@redwood.com) and reply-all with the PO reference when available. I’ve attached the short addendum language (in-line below) — nothing contractual, just a technical enablement and revocation clause.

Attachment: SOW_CedarWave_v1.pdf (scope) — as shared earlier.

If you want me to host a 15-min call to walk procurement through the vendor form I can do that today.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

On behalf of Redwood: temporary access provisioned; monitoring ticket #RW-19283-ACCESS created and assigned to CS Ops.
